name: @gjsify/integration-chokidar
description: Integration tests: chokidar on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/fs's FSWatcher (fs.watch) + StatWatcher (fs.watchFile) end-to-end — the file-watching surface every TypeScript-aware dev tool (Vite, Rolldown, esbuild --watch, tsc --watch) depends on.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run setup-fixtures && gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
